entries.description: How a client certificate would be picked from the Windows store (СпособВыбораСертификатаWindows): Auto, or Choose when more than one certificate fits and a person should pick.

A request for a client certificate from the Windows store (СертификатКлиентаWindows). New WindowsClientCertificate() asks for Auto. New WindowsClientCertificate(WindowsCertificateSelectMode.Choose) asks for the system dialog.

SelectionMode reads that request back. The Windows store is not opened, and no certificate bytes are loaded: this value records the selection and nothing more. A secure connection still takes a CertificateFile.
entries.parameters: selection — WindowsCertificateSelectMode.Auto or WindowsCertificateSelectMode.Choose. Left out, it is Auto. A number or another type is a refusal: "WindowsClientCertificate: the selection is a WindowsCertificateSelectMode value".
